parts.text: In this experiment you will investigate the position of the image in a plane mirror. Carry out the following instructions, using the separate ray-trace sheet provided. You may refer to Fig. 3.1 for guidance.

parts.label: i
parts.text: (a) (i) Draw a line 10 cm long near the middle of the ray-trace sheet. Label the line MR . Draw a normal to this line that passes through the centre of MR . Label the normal NL . Label the point at which NL crosses MR with the letter B . [1]

ms.label: 3(a)(i)
ms.text: Normal at 90° and in centre of MR

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Draw a line 7.0 cm long from B at an angle of incidence i = 30° to the normal below MR and to the left of the normal. Label the end of this line A . [1]

ms.label: 3(a)(ii)
ms.text: AB at 30° below MR and to left of normal

parts.label: iii
parts.text: (iii) Place a pin P 1 on line AB at a distance 6.0 cm from B . Place a pin P 2 on line AB close to MR . [1]

ms.label: 3(a)(iii)
ms.text: P2 at least 5.0 cm from P1

parts.label: i
parts.text: (b) (i) Place the reflecting face of the mirror vertically on the line MR . View the images of pins P 1 and P 2 from the direction indicated by the eye in Fig. 3.1. Place two pins P 3 and P 4 some distance apart so that pin P 3 and the images of P 2 and P 1 all appear exactly behind pin P 4 . Label the positions of P 3 and P 4 . Remove the pins and the mirror and draw the line joining the positions of P 3 and P 4 . [1]

ms.label: 3(b)(i)
ms.text: Neat line joining P3 and P4

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Continue the line until it extends at least 7.0 cm beyond MR . [1]

ms.label: 3(b)(ii)
ms.text: Line extended at least 7.0 cm beyond MR

parts.label: c
parts.text: (c) Replace pin P 1 on line AB at a distance 6.0 cm from B . Place pin P 2 1.0 cm to the right of its position in part (a) . Repeat the steps in part (b) . Label with the letter Y the point where the two lines cross beyond MR .

parts.label: i
parts.text: (i) Draw a line from P 1 to MR that meets MR at a right angle. Measure and record the length a of this line. a = ..................................................... [1]

ms.label: 3(c)(i)
ms.text: a and b correctly measured to ± 2 mm

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Draw a line from the point labelled Y to MR that meets MR at a right angle. Measure and record the length b of this line. b = ..................................................... [1]

parts.label: i
parts.text: (d) (i) Replace the mirror on MR . Place pin P 1 on the normal at a distance 6.0 cm from the front of the mirror. View the image of P 1 in the mirror. Place pin P 2 on the normal behind the mirror. Adjust the position of P 2 along the normal so that the image of the bottom of the pin P 1 seen in the mirror and the top of pin P 2 seen over the mirror appear as one pin when viewed from all angles in front of the mirror. Label the position of P 2 . [1]

ms.label: 3(d)(i)
ms.text: P1 and P2 in approximately correct positions

parts.label: ii
parts.text: (ii) Remove the pins and the mirror. Measure the distance x along the normal between P 2 and the mirror. x = ..................................................... [2]

ms.label: 3(d)(ii)
ms.text:
x correctly measured to ± 2 mm
x = 5.7 – 6.3 cm

ms.label: 3(e)
ms.text:
Any one from:
Thickness to mirror
Thickness of lines
Difficulty in judging exact lining up of pins.
